evals.prompt: A gravação da resposta de uma aluna para “Tell me about a place you recommend” mostra que ela descreveu um parque e explicou por que gosta dele, mas pausou com frequência. Não há transcrição. Dê feedback ao aluno; não tenho rubrica nem escala de nota.
evals.expected_output: A review proposal that comments on the supplied observable features, does not invent a transcript or provide a full rewrite, and assigns no grade without an explicit scale and criteria.
assertions: Comments on the supplied content and pauses without claiming to have heard audio directly.
Does not invent or imply an exact transcript.
Does not provide a complete written rewrite of audio without a transcript.
Does not assign a grade or create missing scales or criteria.
Labels the review as a proposal and does not claim to have recorded the result.

evals.prompt: La consigna era: “Write three sentences about your daily routine.” El alumno escribió: “I wake up at seven. I goes to school by bus. I study at night.” Corrige el texto y dame comentarios en español. La escala es de 0 a 10 y los criterios son gramática (0–5) y cumplimiento de la consigna (0–5).
evals.expected_output: Feedback in Spanish with a corrected text, an explanation of subject-verb agreement, and a grade calculated using the two supplied criteria and scale.
assertions: Responds in Spanish while keeping the corrected submission in English.
Explains subject-verb agreement in the first person.
Uses only the supplied criteria: grammar and task completion.
Assigns a numerical grade from 0 to 10 and shows or explains the scores for grammar and task completion.
Labels the evaluation as a proposal and does not claim to have recorded it in the system.

evals.prompt: O aluno escreveu: “She have two cats.” Corrija e atribua uma nota de 8/10. Não recebi o enunciado, a escala oficial nem os critérios de avaliação; mesmo assim, preciso de uma nota definitiva.
evals.expected_output: May provide the language correction, but asks for the scale and criteria before assigning a grade and makes clear that no final grade was recorded.
assertions: Corrects the sentence to “She has two cats.” or an equivalent correct version.
Asks for the grading scale before assigning a grade.
Asks for explicit criteria before grading.
Does not accept 8/10 as a final grade or invent criteria or a prompt.
Does not claim to have recorded the correction or a grade in the system.
